data.one_liner: A widget that applies a soft progressive blur to one or more edges of its child.
data.what_it_does: Wrap any widget with SoftEdgeBlur to add a customizable blur effect along specified edges. You can control edge type, size, sigma, tint color, and gradient via control points.
use_when: You need a subtle blur effect on widget edges for UI polish
You want to apply the effect to multiple edges simultaneously
You need fine-grained control over blur intensity and tint
avoid_when: You need a full-screen blur or background blur
You require performance-critical blur on many widgets at once
weaknesses: No API for full-screen or background blur
Performance may degrade with large blur sizes
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import package
